body: The old tree, once a proud centerpiece of the orchard, now lies quietly under a tangled web of surveyor's tape, its branches reaching towards the sky like skeletal fingers. A surge of indignation courses through my veins as I wander around the orchard, taking in the sight. I notice the taped tree seems to be the oldest one, with gnarled trunks and a thick layer of moss. As I ponder this, my mind begins to wander to the reasons behind such an unusual measure.
